segments.en: Set your heart well — to every single word of our words!

Moshiach will draw down and reveal in the entire world the daas of the true Tzadik — in a wondrous revelation and a wondrous and true intellect — in such ultimate perfection — that through this all will walk in the paths of teshuvah — and will return to Hashem Yisburach, etc. — and will return, etc., etc. And even the most distant ones and all the heretics and utter unbelievers will return to Hashem Yisburach and walk in His Torah teachings — Amen and Amen.
